name: Doll ~Uroboros ni Na o Tsuraneru Mono~
original_name: DOLL～ウロボロスに名を連ねる者～
source:
The medieval country of Ouroboros is in trouble. An evil earl has been oppressing the population, imposing heavy taxes and establishing an iron rule. This led to tensions with a neighboring country, who thought of a simple solution: send an assassin to the earl and kill him. The assassin they chose is a highly skilled swordsman named Noel. But as Noel arrives at the earl's castle, he realizes killing him won't be a simple matter. He'll need help, and maybe it will come from a certain young lady and from a mechanical maid in the castle.

Doll: Ouroboros is composed mainly of a huge 3D movie, with some interaction between watching the clips. The interaction is confined to making a decision (a wrong decision will usually lead to Game Over), and choosing one of the several available paths for Noel to take.

[from [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/windows/doll-ouroboros]MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
中世纪国家Ouroboros陷入危机。邪恶伯爵压迫人民，征收重税并实行铁腕统治，导致国家与邻国关系紧张。邻国想出一个简单的解决办法：派刺客杀死伯爵。他们选中的刺客是剑术高超的Noel。然而抵达伯爵城堡后，Noel发现杀死目标并非易事。他需要帮助，而援手或许来自某位年轻女子，以及城堡中的机械女仆。

《Doll: Ouroboros》主要由一段大型3D影片构成，观看片段之间会穿插少量互动。互动仅限于做出决定——错误选择通常会导致Game Over——以及从几条可用路线中选择Noel接下来要走的道路。

[摘自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/windows/doll-ouroboros]MobyGames[/url]]
